name: prompt-evaluation-dataset
description: Dataset for evaluating how rules files and prompt files improve code generation quality

testCases.name: Array Utility Function Generation
testCases.description: Generate a function that filters and transforms array data with error handling

input.prompt: Create a JavaScript function called 'processNumbers' that takes an array of numbers and returns a new array containing only the even numbers, each multiplied by 2. The function should handle edge cases like empty arrays, null/undefined inputs, and non-numeric values.

testCases.name: User Management Class Creation
testCases.description: Generate a class for managing user data with validation and CRUD operations

input.prompt: Create a JavaScript class called 'UserManager' that manages a collection of user objects. Each user should have properties: id, name, email, and age. The class should have methods: addUser(user), getUserById(id), updateUser(id, updates), deleteUser(id), and getAllUsers(). Include proper validation for email format and age (must be positive number). The class should throw appropriate errors for invalid operations.
